name: Ski Saint-Bruno
description: Just 25 minutes from Montreal, Ski Saint-Bruno is the perfect snow oasis for learning to ski in an urban environment, or for intermediate skiers and snowboarders who want to improve their technique. This family-friendly location is ideal for making the most of winter days on one of the ski slopes, in the snow parks or in the heart of an enchanted forest that lights up the hearts of little ones with its mysterious creatures, magical scenery and unique evening lighting!
